---

This repository contains the WoW Lab website, application, Open Graph worker, shared frontend code, email templates, and Supabase Edge Functions.

## Development

Install Node.js 24 and Deno 2, then install the workspace dependencies:

```console
corepack enable
pnpm install
cp apps/landing/.env.local.example apps/landing/.env.local
cp apps/studio/.env.local.example apps/studio/.env.local
```

Run Studio:

```console
pnpm dev
```

Studio runs at `app.localhost:3000`. Use `pnpm dev:landing` for Landing at `localhost:3001` or `pnpm dev:og` for the Open Graph worker.

Replace the placeholder values in the local environment files for features that use those services.

Use `pnpm check` for the full local gate. Generated Markdown comes from the adjacent `.md.in` files; run `pnpm docs:generate` after changing a source template or package metadata.

## Structure

| Path                                             | What it is                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| [`apps/landing`](apps/landing/README.md)         | WoW Lab marketing/landing site (Next.js)           |
| [`apps/og`](apps/og/README.md)                   | WoW Lab Open Graph image worker                    |
| [`apps/studio`](apps/studio/README.md)           | WoW Lab web application (Next.js)                  |
| [`apps/tail`](apps/tail/README.md)               | Cloudflare error collector for WoW Lab             |
| [`packages/emails`](packages/emails/README.md)   | Supabase Auth email templates for WoW Lab          |
| [`packages/scripts`](packages/scripts/README.md) | Development and deployment tooling for WoW Lab Web |
| [`packages/shared`](packages/shared/README.md)   | Shared source for WoW Lab apps                     |
| [`supabase`](supabase/README.md)                 | Edge Functions and local Supabase configuration    |
